items.file: Statue of Unity.jpg
items.title: Statue of Unity
items.description: The Statue of Unity is the world's tallest statue with a height of 182 metres (597 ft). It is a colossal statue of Indian statesman and independence activist Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel (1875–1950) who was the first Home minister of India and the chief adherent of Mahatma Gandhi during the non-violent Indian Independence movement; highly respected for his leadership in uniting the 562 princely states
